tei:div.tei:p: /shel ma sgom chen la gdams pa'i zhus lan ma rig mun sel zhes bya ba bzhugs so//

/bu yi dam pa slob ma'i yang rab/ shel ma sgom chen gyi nyams rtogs phul ba'i lan/ med pa spangs phyir mdor bsdus shig brjod par bya ste/ de yang sngon gyi bsod nams kyi bsags pa la brten nas/ rang re dang thug skra bcad cing rab tu byung*/ sems kyi skyong thabs thob pa nas bzung ste/ khrims dang ldan cing sgrub tshugs zin pa byung ba shin tu ngo mtshar che zhing rjes su yi rang*/ de rjes gsang phu slob dpon shes rab dbang phyug pa'i mdun du sbyor ba yan lag drug pa'i rnal 'byor nyams su blangs la/ lus zug dang mig tsha ba sems bde sdug sna tshogs byung ba dang*/ rigs drug gi gnas sbyong rnams shar ba rtsa rlung gi byed pa yin te/ bcom ldan 'das kyi zhal nas/ nyi ma gcig ni nges par brtag /gal te rtags de ma byung na// de ni nga yi rdzun tshig yin// zhes gsungs pas/ nyams snang sna tshogs 'byung ba yin te/ skyon yon gang du yang ma ltas par bskyang chog pa de yin/ de rjes lus la na tsha yid ma ches byung nas/ bsnyen sgrub byas pa legs te/ thabs shes ya ma bral ba dgos te/ snying rje dang bral stong pa nyid zhugs gang*// des kyang lam mchog rnyed pa ma yin no// zhes sa ra has gsungs pas/ bsnyen sgrub sbrags pas/ sbrul dang sbal lcong sogs don pa rmis pa chod tshad kyi rnam pa red/ yi dam gyi lhas lung bstan pa 'dra ba'i rnam pa dang*/ bzang ngan ci yang 'char ba thams cad la bden 'dzin byed du mi btub/ skyon du 'ang blta rgyu med/ dge sbyor rang rgyun sring skyong dgos rgyu yin/ gzhan gyi dmigs pa gtong rogs byas pa dang*/ mi chos pas rogs byas res thig res ma thig pa thams cad gtad pa med/ dga' ldan pa'i bla ma tshor chos zhus pa la skyon yong ba 'dug sa bka' rnying gsum la dga' ldan pa tshos dam nyams byas pa'i skyon red/ lhas lung bstan pa rnams yid ma ches na'ang*/ da lo dgun chos dus ngas bshad pa tsho dang sems thog gcig par byung*/

sems la phan/ dge sbyor la bogs thon byung na/ de ga rang gis chog skyob pa'i zhal nas/ dus dang spyod lam gang du'ang*// bya byed mthong snang sna tshogs rnams// rang gi sgom dang gang mthun bsten// bla ma'i byin rlabs zhugs pa yin/ gsungs pa yod pa yin/ 'phral bsnyen sgrub rang la sgril/ dge sbyor kyang 'ded ma thub pa bden/ mnyam rjes khyad med par ngo lta phog pa rang gis chog pa byung yang*/ ched du ma 'dzin/ yang rjes thob dus su rtsol bas ston kyang*/ 'phar 'bub byung ba cis kyang bden te/ de yang ro snyoms la skyongs dang*/ snang rkyen dang yul rkyen thub tu song byung na mnyam gzhag la nus pa thon pa yin/ skyong mtshams rang gal che/ 'dzin med kyi ngang du yengs med rang skyongs/ bka' brgyud rin po che chos kyi rlabs che drags pas ngo shes pa bskyang bas chog skyong mtshams dang ngo sprod zur pa 'di shel ma sgom chen la gdams pa'o// //
